TailorCV autofill fixtures

Load the unpacked extension, open a page, then in DevTools → Console switch the context dropdown from top to TailorCV and call __tcvAutofill.selfTest() (or __tcvAutofill.diagnose()). Extension globals are not visible from the default top context. selfTest runs the real pipeline with the network stubbed and prints a table of every field and whether the page verified what was written.

These pages cover what the jsdom suites cannot: real layout (geometric visibility), a real DataTransfer (file attach), portal-rendered dropdown menus driven by real pointer events, and innerText.

  • Greenhouse — react-select comboboxes, a file input hidden behind an Attach button, EEO dropdowns, and sensitive questions that must stay unanswered.
  • Greenhouse (current markup) — Today's job-boards.greenhouse.io: two sibling question sections, the phone country picker whose flyout holds an input[type=search], and an upload named by its wrapping group rather than its Attach label. Real layout matters here — this is the shape that broke discovery.
  • Lever — Labels that are SIBLINGS of their inputs with no for, bracketed field names, and a radio group with no fieldset.
  • Workday — data-automation-id attributes, a radio group with no shared name, and a phone field beside its own country-code picker.
  • Ashby — ARIA-driven comboboxes and a native date input.
  • Generic careers page — A plain hand-written form — the long-tail case with no ATS behind it.
  • Decoys only — A search box, a newsletter signup and a login form. NOTHING should be detected here and no panel should offer to autofill.
  • Workday (late render, real markup) — The form renders ~3 seconds after load, as on citi.wd5 / pwc.wd3.myworkdayjobs.com. The sidebar should first show nothing to fill, then offer Autofill this application by itself. "Next step" below simulates Save and Continue: the fields change, the URL does not, and the sidebar should offer page 2.
  • Upload variants — A plain file input, one hidden behind a button, and a drag-and-drop-only zone that listens for drop and ignores change. jsdom has no DataTransfer, so this page is the only place the attach path is genuinely proven.
  • Portal-rendered dropdown — A dropdown whose menu is rendered into a <body>-level portal and which commits on mousedown, like react-select. Also a conditional field that only appears once the first is answered.

What to check

  1. Every field the table says was written shows verified: ok.
  2. Work authorization, sponsorship, salary and the EEO questions are never filled from anything but the stored profile values above.
  3. The upload page's drop zone reports the file it received.
  4. The portal dropdown commits a real option, and the conditional field that appears afterwards is picked up.
  5. The decoys page detects nothing.
  6. No page is ever submitted.
